//: Typecheck-only config for the Perry NIKKE viewer.
Perry erases types, so it will compile nonsense that tsc rejects. This
config catches misuse of the rasen / WebGPU / perry-ui API surfaces before
paying for a native build: `yarn tsc -p .`
`perry/ui` is not an npm package - the compiler injects it and the runtime
ships no declarations. The vendored copy under `types/perry/` comes from the
Perry source tree (`types/perry/ui/index.d.ts`) so this example typechecks
